reader.requirement: At --std 85 an indexed file's FILE STATUS clause follows the Sequential I-O clause (§1985:VII.2.5): data-name-1 may be qualified and must be a two-character alphanumeric item outside the File, Report and Communication Sections (else refused), and the item named in the file's own entry is updated with the indexed I-O status (§1985:IX.1.3.4) every time that file's I-O status is updated, by every statement.

reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: at 2002 the FILE STATUS operand may be subscripted (kb/Work PB5602); 85 refuses it as 2023 does
